description:
As MASSIVE Marvel fans and YouTube Ice Cream makers, it was only a matter of time until we made Avengers Hunka Hulka Burning Fudge. 
With no known recipe or even flavour to go by, we decided to just give a bash (pun intended) and see what comes from it. 

So without further ado, let's make Avengers Hunka Hulka Burning Fudge Ice Cream....

For the base:

400ml Milk
500ml Double Cream
150g Sugar
100g Marshmallows chopped and melted in the milk (use GOOD m/mallows)
Green colouring 

For the Crack Top (I should've called it a SMASH top really!):
White Chocolate 75g
Water 6ml (a tad over 1 tsp)
Green Food Colouring

The Fudge:
400ml Condensed Milk
340g Dark Chocolate
Melt both ingredients and pour in to a mould. Keep in the fridge until ready. We grated ours so kept a piece in the freezer to help with grating. 

Fudge Core:
125g Dairy Milk Chocolate
125g Butter
1 Egg
30g Castor Sugar
15g Glucose Syrup

Once your base is cooled in the fridge, churn it in your machine, 5 minutes from the end of the churn, add your grated fudge flecks. 
Use whatever you have to hand to make a well in the ice cream for your fudge core. Store the tub in the freezer for 20 minutes, then remove the core mould and pour in your fudge core mix. 
Finally, make your water ganache and pour it over the top. Gently pop it in the freezer for at least 4 hours to allow the chocolate top to harden completely. 

Get your HULK on and smash your way through the top and enjoy this amazing ice cream.
